review_scope: Independent adversarial review of frozen fresh Tier1 pre-implementation contract; no production edits and no reliance on other review decisions.

assessments: F1 adds exactly the fixed -XX:TieredStopAtLevel=1 before existing headless property. Complete argv extraction/delta/order verification is mandatory; required mount, limits, environment clearing, constructor BuildIdentity, launch BuildIdentity and Alloy hash checks remain.

Package-private immutable enum has no public/request/environment flag surface. Only DocumentQueries advisory validate construction may select F1 after gates. DocumentMutations factory remains default, WorkerMain solver flags remain unchanged, nondefault document profile rejects revalidate before launch. Separately named gate-only regression launcher does not weaken that guard.

Existing BubblewrapLauncher actual constructor and launch checks match retained contract fences; DocumentQueries creates a fresh worker, and mutation factories use DocumentWorker::new. Prototype must exercise actual launch and unchanged FrameProcess transport/reap rather than command()+ProcessBuilder bypass.

Complete decoded private response comparator covers every field and independent contract oracle; only generated IDs may receive validated injective kind-preserving mapping in schema-declared slots. Existing IDs, literals, diagnostics and source remain exact. Swapped edges, aliases, changed diagnostics/trivia/source and unapproved generated-ID locations are required comparator rejection fixtures.

Finite differential/security/cleanup matrix precedes performance. Three independently restarted F0/F1 pairs use declared alternating order, serial real HTTP 500-node workload with 100 warmups/1000 measured, zero errors, strict p95<300ms, <=5GiB peak and strict improvement over paired baseline in every run. Failures and outliers cannot be averaged or omitted.

Whole server stack is contained by effective 4-CPU quota/6GiB ceiling with 5GiB high limit, no swap, bounded PIDs; actual containment and descendant cleanup evidence required. Driver remains outside group; uncontained fallback prohibited.

Lean claims are guarded syntactic/lifecycle/selection results. RequiredArgs extraction, identity/reap observations and Run measurements are explicitly trusted adapters; hypothetical selection witness is not performance evidence. Runner pins six approvals and inputs, audits exact types/axioms, checks inherited anchors and requires two isolated matching builds.

limitations: Approval authorizes only conforming bounded prototype/implementation and remains subject to all stated safety, runtime and selection gates. It does not select F1 or certify an implementation.
No clean Lean build was executed in this review; two isolated matching builds remain required after six approvals. Static exact source/type/claim/audit/axiom inventory check passed.

Concrete fixtures, comparator, harness, bytecode/source delta and runtime verifier hashes must be frozen before comparative execution; this candidate contains a preregistered design, not completed finite runtime evidence.
Finite response equivalence is not universal JIT semantic equivalence. Model durability and identity fields do not independently establish database invariance or OS ownership.
Workstation 4-CPU quota/6GiB screening does not establish intended 4vCPU/8GiB server acceptance. Actual target protocol remains OPEN.
Alloy/dependency redistribution, customer/browser/security and other commercial release gates remain separately NO_GO until closed.
commercial_scope: Fresh advisory-only fixed compiler-flag experiment and conforming implementation; excludes warm/reused JVMs, AppCDS, packaging changes, caches, SQL changes, mutation optimization, solver deployment changes and commercial release approval.
